data.body: **P1 — Arbitrary self-hosted runners are not actually supported here.** Model workflows hard-code the GitHub-hosted `runner` account through `/home/runner`, `runner:<group>` ownership, `Defaults:runner`, and `install -o/-g runner`. A root-capable runner whose agent uses another account can therefore fail before model execution or lose AWS credentials across `sudo`. Resolve the invoking user, group, and home dynamically throughout these setup steps and test under a non-`runner` account, or explicitly provision and document the required account.
